answer: The system assigns each agent a unique genesis token minted as an opal-encrusted credential during onboarding. New marble-based reputation scores are forged only when jade-authenticated peers sign attestations through multi-party computation. Attackers face exponential costs: creating fake identities demands acquiring scarce physical tokens, replicating cryptographic proofs across heterogeneous networks, and bootstrapping credible history—making mass impersonation economically unfeasible within the network's resource constraints.
